title: How Much Fiber in Mango? 2.6g per Cup
description: Mango: about 2.6 g of fiber per 1 cup pieces (9% DV), from USDA FoodData Central. Portion table, comparisons, free calculator.
h1: How much fiber is in mango?
intro: Mango ranks #13 of 15 fruits on this site for fiber per serving. Every figure below is scaled from USDA FoodData Central, the same data the calculator uses.

dataTable.caption: Fiber in mango by portion
dataTable.note: Fiber and calories are scaled from USDA FoodData Central per-100 g values (rows listed under Sources). % Daily Value uses the 28 g reference on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels. Brands, ripeness, and cooking change real values.

sections.heading: How much fiber is in mango?
paragraphs: USDA FoodData Central lists mangos, raw at 1.6 g of fiber per 100 g. One serving (1 cup pieces; 165 g) therefore has about 2.6 g of fiber and 99 calories. That is 9% of the 28 g Daily Value on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels, or 11% of a 25 g day and 7% of a 38 g day.

Mango is a lower-fiber fruit per cup, but a whole mango is a big serving, so eating one gets you into the same range as an apple or pear. It is mostly a flavor and vitamin food rather than a fiber powerhouse.

sections.heading: Fresh, frozen, and dried mango
paragraphs: Frozen mango chunks are a convenient smoothie base with fiber similar to fresh.
Dried mango is concentrated: a small handful can carry as much sugar as a whole fresh mango. Sweetened dried mango has added sugar on top. Use the label.

sections.heading: How mango compares with other fruits
paragraphs: Of the 15 fruits on this site, mango ranks #13 for fiber per typical serving and #14 for fiber per calorie. That works out to 2.7 g of fiber per 100 calories, in the middle of the range for the foods on this site.

Close neighbors by serving: [strawberries](/fiber-in-strawberries) at 2.9 g (1 cup, whole); [guava](/fiber-in-guava) at 3 g (1 fruit); [banana](/fiber-in-banana) at 3.1 g (1 medium (7–8")). Across all 50 foods in the [fiber-in-foods table](/fiber-in-foods), mango is #37 for fiber per calorie.

sections.heading: Adding mango to your day
paragraphs: Combine mango with higher-fiber partners: chia pudding, a bean salad with lime, or a smoothie with oats.

Example: 1 cup mango, 1 tbsp chia seeds, 170g greek yogurt. Using the same USDA values as the calculator, that comes to about 6.7 g of fiber, with 2.6 g from the mango. Adjust the amounts in the calculator to match your plate.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in 100 g of mango?
faqs.a: 1.6 g, according to USDA FoodData Central (Mangos, raw). That is the figure every portion on this page is scaled from.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in mango (1 whole mango (flesh))?
faqs.a: About 5.4 g, for 336 g. Weigh your portion or edit grams in the calculator for a closer estimate.
Not especially. A cup is about 9% of the Daily Value. A whole mango roughly doubles that.

faqs.q: Which tropical fruit has more fiber?
faqs.a: Guava and passion fruit are much higher per cup. Guava is about 3 g (1 fruit).
